stem: How does the use of a cause-and-effect structure in paragraphs 4 through 6 of the article “An Ancient Farming Method” help support the topic of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: It emphasizes how dramatically the Inca advanced previously existing ways of farming.

options.label: B
options.text: It reveals that some crops were harder to grow than others in the area where the Inca lived.

options.label: C
options.text: It explains the purposes of various strategies the Inca used to help maintain their crops.

options.label: D
options.text: It demonstrates how much the Inca needed to experiment in order to develop their farming style.
